text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're in a good mood, Rice. Did<n>something exciting
happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, actually... I set a new personal<n>record at
practice earlier!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I tried out a new running technique I<n>learned
yesterday, and—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let me guess, your "Big Brother"<n>taught you this
technique?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let me guess, your "Big Sister"<n>taught you this
technique?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sorry. Sometimes, when I'm<n>reading late at
night...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I hear you happily murmuring "Thank<n>you, Big
Brother" in your sleep.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I hear you happily murmuring "Thank<n>you, Big
Sister" in your sleep.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: S-sorry. I wasn't trying to tease you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I can only imagine how incredible they<n>must be for
you to be so thankful.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... Big Brother is the best<n>trainer ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... Big Sister is the best trainer<n>ever!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower talks excitedly for a<n>while, sharing
many words of<n>admiration.
